info.title: OpenAsy Metrics API
info.summary: The numbers behind your systems: scraped, kept in VictoriaMetrics, graphed and queried with PromQL.
info.description:
Every screen of Metrics uses this API, and so can your scripts (ADR 0014). Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only; anything removed is deprecated first (ADR 0024). Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

PromQL is answered under `/prometheus` exactly as Prometheus answers it, so Grafana, vmalert and any Prometheus client take `https://metrics.example.com/prometheus` as a Prometheus data source, with an API token as bearer token. Samples are pushed with `METRICS_INGEST_TOKEN`: OpenTelemetry metrics to `/opentelemetry/v1/metrics`, Prometheus remote write to `/prometheus/api/v1/write`. Everything else takes the session of a signed-in person or an API token, and each operation names the role it needs (`x-openasy-role`: viewer, editor, admin; ADR 0003).

Sign-in, members and API tokens are under `/api/v1/auth`, provided by [@openasy/auth](https://github.com/openasy/auth#routes).

session.name: __Host-openasy-session
session.description: The browser session after signing in (`openasy-session` when Metrics runs on plain http://localhost). Requests that change something must come from the Metrics origin.

apiToken.description: An API token created under Settings → API tokens (`oa_metrics_...`): one role, always an expiry (ADR 0003). Grafana sends one as its data source's bearer token.

adminToken.description: Only when Metrics is started by its tests or a local script: one shared token with the admin role. A production install does not have it.

ingestToken.description: `METRICS_INGEST_TOKEN`: for OpenTelemetry collectors and Prometheus remote write. It can push samples, nothing else.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

id.description: The product, as OpenAsy names it.

url.description: The address people open it at.

job.description: The job; `openasy` for the OpenAsy products Metrics scrapes itself.

product.description: The OpenAsy product, for targets of the job openasy.

jobId.description: The job's id, for a job people added.

labels.description: The labels of every series it brings, but job.

health.description: Of the last scrape; unknown before the first.

hasSecret.description: Whether a password or bearer token is kept. It is never returned (ADR 0021).

name.description: The job label of what it reads. `openasy` is taken.

urls.description: http:// or https:// addresses; one without a path reads /metrics.

labels.description: Added to every series it reads; at most 20, not job and none starting with __.

secret.description: The bearer token or password, sealed with the install's key. Leave it out to keep the one kept.

expr.description: PromQL; each series it returns is one line.

unit.description: How values are shown: percent is 0 to 100, ratio 0 to 1 shown as a percent.

legend.description: How a line is named, such as {{instance}}; empty names it by its labels.

unit.description: How values are shown: percent is 0 to 100, ratio 0 to 1 shown as a percent.

builtIn.description: Comes with Metrics; it cannot be changed, only copied.

type.description: counter, gauge, histogram or summary, as the target sent it.

series.description: Its series now; null when it is not among the 1000 metrics with the most.

running.description: Whether VictoriaMetrics answers. When it does not, the numbers are 0.

refusedSeries.description: New series refused by METRICS_MAX_SERIES since VictoriaMetrics started.

products.description: OpenAsy products scraped, besides Metrics itself.
